alignment_method: nearest route arc to each GPS observation within radius
reference_arc_source: sequential arc IDs from each trip .route file
positive_label: candidate arc equals nearest route arc
negative_label: candidate arc differs from nearest route arc
unlabeled_policy: leave candidate rows unlabeled when no route arc aligns to the GPS
candidate_miss_policy: record reference arc misses separately; never fabricate positive labels
sequence_assumption: route arc sequence is used as reference set, while GPS-to-arc association is spatial
evaluator_policy: evaluator partitions and labels are never read
limitations: route row count is not assumed to equal GPS row count
a route arc may be nearest to no GPS observation
one GPS observation can align to only one nearest route arc
spatial alignment does not establish exact turn-level route state
